passive.name: Salvation
passive.text: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.

spells.name: Starcall
spells.text: A star falls from the sky at the target location dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If an enemy champion is hit by Starcall, Soraka recovers Health.

spells.name: Astral Infusion
spells.text: Soraka sacrifices a portion of her own health to heal another friendly champion.

spells.name: Equinox
spells.text: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.

spells.name: Wish
spells.text: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.

damage.value: Soraka deals burst magic damage with Starcall.

archetype.value: Soraka is a support who preserves her health so she can keep healing allies.

winCondition.value: Soraka wins prolonged fights by arriving healthy and providing sustained healing.

spikes.why: Rejuvenation helps Soraka heal without draining her health as quickly.

bait.why: When Soraka spends Starcall, its cooldown leaves her without its damage, slow, and champion-hit healing.
When Soraka spends Astral Infusion, its cooldown leaves her unable to use it to heal another allied champion.
When Soraka spends Wish, its cooldown leaves her unable to instantly heal herself and all allied champions again.

mistakes.value: Soraka wastes healing potential when she repeatedly uses Astral Infusion without first landing Starcall.
Soraka risks a lead when she enters fog of war alone without checking for threats.
Soraka loses impact when she heals only the nearest ally instead of the one whose survival matters most.
